title: Paint the Dungeon Green
description: Paint the Dungeon Green — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Kent the Artisan

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Sir Kent says that, believe it or not, Oroks are really pink! They carry green paint to touch themselves up. Collect the following things from enemies in Algernon:

  • 7 cans of green paint, by killing Oroks in Orok Outpost.

Quest Reward: 750 Gold + 1 KC

Return to: Sir Kent the Artisan

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 7 Buckets of Green Paint from the Orok Scouts, Orok Spawns, Orok Warriors, Fizz Water-Soaked Broodlings, Fizz Water-Soaked Blademasters, and Fizz Water Gunners. Afterward, return to Artisan Kent on Level 1 of Algernon.

Offer:

If you want to do me a favor, you can go out and grab me 7 Buckets of Green Paint. They should be easy to come by since the Oroks that are here in Algernon just freaking love green. I heard a rumor that their real skin color is fuchsia but they have spray-on tinting booths that they use to make them green. Who knows if it is true or not, but it sure is funny! Oh, there are also some Poison Whiskers that you can collect the paint from. Just do not drink the paint or, like, pour it on open wounds. The paint from the Poison Whiskers is not really paint but a latex-based poison. Works great though.

Find the Oroks and Poison Whiskers here in Algernon and kill them to collect the Buckets of Green Paint. When you have all you need you can return to me, Sir Kent the Artisan, here on Level 1 of Algernon.

Turn-in:

Ahh, great! I need that paint right now so I can put the finishing touches on the diorama reenactment of last years Festival of Brunch. It was quite a sight! Someone made some bad potato salad and everyone who ate it got sick. Hahahaha, oh man, I should not be laughing but I just cannot help it!

Objectives:

  • Green Paint ×7

Level range: 3–20
